The SEO services in your results that **actually measure whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini mention your business** are the ones that explicitly track **brand mentions/citations across those three engines** rather than just general SEO rankings.[2][7][8][15][17][18]

The strongest matches are:

- **OtterlyAI** — explicitly says it tracks brand visibility and citations across **ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity**.[7][17]
- **Profound** — listed as tracking **ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini** with citation tracking and AI visibility analytics.[8][15][18]
- **Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit / SEOmonitor AI search tracking** — these track AI mentions/citations and include **ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini** in their coverage.[1][3][6][11][13]
- **Rankscale AI** — listed as tracking **ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity** with citations and mentions.[14][15]
- **Peec AI** — included in coverage lists for **AI Mode, ChatGPT, AI Overviews, Copilot, Gemini, and Perplexity**.[15]
- **AI Rank Lab / Ryze AI / Keyword.com AI Tracker** — these appear in comparison pages as tools for multi-engine brand mention tracking, including the major LLMs you named.[16]

A few clarifications matter:

- Some tools only track **ChatGPT + AI Overviews** or **ChatGPT + Perplexity**, so they do **not** fully satisfy your exact three-engine requirement unless Gemini is also listed.[1][3][5]
- Some results are **blog roundups**, not vendor documentation, so the most reliable confirmations are the product pages or vendor pages that directly state platform coverage.[1][3][7][15][17]
- If you want the safest shortlist based on the sources here, start with **OtterlyAI, Profound, Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit, and Rankscale AI** because they are repeatedly described as measuring **mentions/citations** across the engines you care about.[7][8][11][14][15]

If you want, I can turn this into a **buying shortlist** with columns for **exact engine coverage, citation tracking, pricing, and whether they track prompts vs. whole-domain visibility**.
